reason: Milestone 2 start: record Intent Graph's own goals, decisions, requirements, components and milestone obligations from the architecture document.

record.label: Preserve the connection between what a person wants and what software does
record.description: Make intent, interpretation, design choices and implementation evidence explicit and connected, as both evolve.

annotations.text: The purpose is to preserve the connection between what a person wants and what software actually does as both evolve.
Token savings, reduced defects and faster development are hypotheses to evaluate, not established claims.

record.label: Operate as a lightweight local package used by an existing coding assistant
record.description: No owned LLM, no chat service, no daemon, no graph database, no account for the base workflow.

record.label: Representations of different precision coexist with explicit links
record.description: A goal may be a paragraph; a rule may gain a formal expression; links say how one interprets or supports another.

record.label: An observation must not silently overwrite a requirement
record.description: Conflicting intended and observed behavior both remain represented until resolved.

record.label: Acceptance, formalization and verification are separate dimensions
record.description: Avoid a universal verified property; evidence is scoped, with method and freshness.

record.label: Only relations with explicit acyclicity semantics are checked for cycles
record.description: Calls, transitions and dependencies may legally cycle.

record.label: Record identity is stable and never derived from labels or paths
Unknown kinds are never silently interpreted as known ones
record.description: A compatibility mode may preserve them, but readiness cannot assume their semantics were validated.

record.label: A single routine computes the content digest over the canonical payload
record.description: Sorted records and keys, UTF-8, non-finite numbers rejected, fixed newline handling, digest field excluded.

record.label: Snapshot writes are atomic and interrupted writes leave a readable snapshot
A patch with a stale base is rejected with the changed ids, never silently rebased
Repeated patch ids with identical content replay safely; different content is an error
A fresh process reconstructs the complete working graph from persisted files
record.description: Caches are disposable and affect performance only.

record.label: Graph text and expressions are data; no eval, source or shell is accepted as an expression
A lens never silently discards a mandatory constraint; it reports overflow or truncation
Execution failure is distinguished from a completed check that found problems
record.description: 0 ok, 2 blockers, 3 invalid input or stale revision, 4 unavailable dependency or internal failure; JSON carries the precise status.

record.label: An agent must not invent user approval to clear a blocker; readiness must not modify its own policy
Annotated graph is the central model

properties.rationale: Supports decomposition, cross-links, queries and mixed precision.

properties.rationale: Simple local implementation; typed records stay independent of the graph library so storage details do not define semantics.

record.label: One canonical snapshot with transactions inside it; no daemon

properties.rationale: Atomic writes and straightforward recovery before sharding; graph state and transaction accounting cannot diverge.

record.label: The existing agent runs language-specific analyzers; the core stays small

properties.rationale: Avoids building a large analyzer platform before proving value.

properties.rationale: A capability cannot be mandatory for building its first implementation; record limitations rather than fabricate checks.
